planned_endpoints.summary: Find cost category corresponding with sent data.

rules: ALWAYS search first: GET /employee?email=<email> — the sandbox often has pre-existing employees. Reuse if found.
Only POST /employee if GET returns 0 results.
When POSTing, ALWAYS include department={"id": dept_id}. Create department first if needed.
userType should be 'NO_ACCESS' (safest default — avoids 422 errors). Only use 'STANDARD' if email login is explicitly needed.
startDate is a TOP-LEVEL field on the employee object. Do NOT put it inside an employments array.
dateOfBirth is a TOP-LEVEL field. Format: 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
jobTitle is set via PUT /employee/{id} AFTER creation — it cannot be set in the initial POST.
Do NOT include an 'employments' array in POST /employee — employment details go via separate POST /employee/employment endpoint.

For occupation codes (STYRK/yrkeskode): POST /employee/employment first, then GET /employee/employment/occupationCode?nameAndCode=XXXX to find the code, then PUT /employee/employment/details to set it.
ALWAYS include project={"id": project_id} if prompt mentions a project.
Paths must NOT include /v2/ prefix — use /travelExpense not /v2/travelExpense.

what_went_wrong: POST /travelExpense/cost returned 422 'cost: Feltet må fylles ut' 5 times — the 'cost' field error likely refers to a missing required field not documented in the schema, possibly 'count' or 'quantity'.
Agent never resolved the core issue with /travelExpense/cost and wasted 5 identical 422 attempts with minor variations instead of trying a fundamentally different payload structure.
Fallback to POST /ledger/voucher failed with 'sum of postings not equal to 0' — agent sent only one debit posting without a balancing credit posting, which is required for manual vouchers.
Score 2/7 (0.286): only 1 of 2 checks passed — the travel expense header was created but the cost line was never successfully attached.
what_worked: POST /travelExpense succeeded on first try, creating the expense header with correct employee and department HR.
Agent correctly identified Hotell cost category and the relevant payment type from the API responses.
what_to_try_next: For /travelExpense/cost, try adding a 'count' field (e.g., 'count': 1) — the 'cost' validation error may be triggered by a missing quantity/count field that the schema doesn't document.
If using /ledger/voucher as fallback, include both debit (expense account 7140) and credit (accounts payable or bank account) postings so the sum equals zero, and use correct inngående MVA vatType.
Inspect a working travel expense cost via GET /travelExpense/cost to see what fields a successfully created cost record contains, then mirror that structure in the POST payload.
unnecessary_calls: GET /travelExpense/costCategory called twice — first call was sufficient, pagination/fields param should have been used to get all results in one call.
GET /currency — unnecessary since NOK currency id=1 could have been assumed or skipped; didn't resolve the core issue.
